reporting_statement: Resource-bounded reproduction using the official DreamCoder List Processing implementation and DSL, under a fixed reduced compute budget. FAST results are not intended to reproduce DreamCoder's published peak performance; they compare library formation and reuse behavior under a tractable fixed compute budget.

notes.missing_metrics: N/A means the frozen adapters did not directly expose the metric; DreamCoder core was not modified to manufacture it.
notes.budget_units: DreamCoder checks and F-system candidate attempts are system-specific; no one-to-one search budget equivalence is claimed.
notes.dreamcoder_revision4_coverage: All three revision-3 DreamCoder processes exited with 0xC0000005 in nvdxgdmal64.dll_unloaded (Windows Application Error 1000); revision 4 records NOT_RUN and does not retry this platform failure. Q1 is N/A and no cross-system aggregate is valid.
notes.f_system_composite_reference_semantics: The old high_order_reuse_count is retained for traceability but counts terminal candidate AST references. It does not establish a solved or hidden-example-verified reuse. Successful unseen composite solutions and direct reuse are reported separately and are zero in every seed.
notes.paired_delta_sign: Expanded minus FIRST_CLASS. Negative values mean EXPANDED used fewer attempts/time under this budget; they do not support a FIRST_CLASS cost reduction.
